# Real BMI — Evidence-Based Health & Fitness Calculators

> Real BMI provides free, evidence-based health, metabolic, and body composition calculators based on official World Health Organization (WHO) and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) standards.

## Health & Fitness Calculators
- [Free BMI Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/bmi-calculator/): Calculate Body Mass Index quickly with WHO-based health categories and instant privacy-first results.
- [Accurate BMR Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/bmr-calculator/): Determine your resting metabolic rate with trusted BMR analysis and energy guidance.
- [TDEE Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/tdee-calculator/): Find your total daily calorie maintenance burn and plan weight loss, gain, or maintenance goals.
- [US Navy Body Fat Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/body-fat-calculator/): Calculate body fat percentage accurately with advanced body composition analysis.
- [Lean Body Mass Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/lean-body-mass-calculator/): Estimate your lean body mass and fat-free weight using published reference formulas.
- [Ideal Weight Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/ideal-weight-calculator/): Determine your healthiest weight range based on height, gender, and body composition.
- [Calorie Target Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/calorie-calculator/): Calculate target calories for fat loss, gain, or maintenance with easy nutrition planning.
- [Daily Protein Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/protein-intake-calculator/): Determine daily protein needs for muscle support, recovery, and body recomposition.
- [Water Intake Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/water-intake-calculator/): Compute your daily hydration target and improve healthy fluid balance.
- [Macro Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/macro-calculator/): Split your calories into carbs, protein, and fat for better meal planning.
- [Waist-to-Hip Ratio Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator/): Assess cardiovascular health risk using waist-to-hip ratio analysis.
- [Body Surface Area Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/body-surface-area-calculator/): Calculate body surface area reference estimates for metabolic context.
- [Target Heart Rate Zone Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/heart-rate-zone-calculator/): Identify exercise heart rate zones for fat burn, cardio, and performance training.
- [One Rep Max Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/one-rep-max-calculator/): Estimate your strength capacity and max lift weight using standard fitness formulas.
- [Pregnancy Weight Gain Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/pregnancy-weight-gain-calculator/): Track recommended gestational weight gain and support healthy pregnancy progress.

## In-Depth Guides & Clinical Resources
- [BMI Chart for Men and Women](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/bmi-chart-for-men-women/): Understand BMI ranges, health categories, and body composition differences across sexes.
- [Healthy BMI Range for Indians](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/healthy-bmi-range-indians/): Learn healthy BMI ranges and culturally relevant guidance for Indian body types.
- [BMI Calculator for Teens](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/bmi-calculator-teens/): Discover teen-specific BMI guidance and wellness planning for younger bodies.
- [Asian BMI Cutoffs Clinical Guide](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/asian-bmi-cutoffs-clinical-guide/): Population-specific BMI thresholds for South Asian and East Asian health contexts.
- [BMR vs TDEE Calculator Guide](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/bmr-vs-tdee-calculator/): Deep dive into resting metabolic expenditure versus total active calorie burn.
- [How to Calculate TDEE](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/how-to-calculate-tdee/): Step-by-step guidance on calculating energy expenditure with activity multipliers.
- [BMR Formulas: Mifflin vs Harris-Benedict](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/bmr-formulas-mifflin-vs-harris-benedict/): Mathematical comparison of modern and legacy basal metabolic formulas.
- [Healthy Calorie Deficit Guide](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/healthy-calorie-deficit-guide/): Evidence-based sustainable fat loss strategies without muscle degradation.
- [Daily Protein Intake Science](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/daily-protein-intake-science/): Clinical recommendations for protein consumption across sedentary, athletic, and elderly demographics.
- [Macro Split Calculator Guide](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/macro-split-calculator-guide/): Balanced macronutrient distribution for wellness, athletic performance, and metabolic health.
- [Daily Water Intake Guide](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/daily-water-intake-guide/): Optimal hydration science according to climate, body weight, and workout intensity.
- [Body Surface Area Mosteller Guide](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/body-surface-area-mosteller-guide/): Physiological applications and calculation of body surface area.
- [Target Heart Rate Training Zones](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/target-heart-rate-training-zones/): Cardiovascular zone training with the Karvonen formula and heart rate reserve.
- [One Rep Max Strength Guide](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/one-rep-max-strength-guide/): Submaximal repetition algorithms for calculating maximum strength output safely.
